criteria.summary: 59 points with four parts and substantive reviews; two justified scope additions.
Native Web and TS precede SFC, state, effects, routing, then Nuxt; React is optional.
Official sources and actual versions checked; rendering, ownership and authorization boundaries distinguished.
Real compiler, component, build, browser, SSR and SSG checks; observation-only examples explicit.
Each exercise has a concrete variant, two or more acceptance checks, reproducible fault and reference.
Integrated tasks match actual Nuxt or standalone labs; baseline and requested extensions distinguished.
Names, source, commands and expectations agree; applicable semantic, security and compatibility checks.
Required findings closed and affected execution, repository checks and historical gates passed.
253 of 585 authored; indexes, limits and next stage synchronized without changing learner checks.

findings.resolution: Watch cleanup and Nuxt page metadata added with explicit rationale.
Native tag preserved and submit handler renamed; SSR redirect loop fixed.
Default SSR separated from explicit SSG; dynamic query and POST limits documented.
Optional meta, real event negative cases, named form status and ASCII HTTP message fixed.
Existing note state and standalone Vue/React capabilities separated; cancellation is an extension.
Real Node, component, browser, SSG and focused error recovery checks passed.

limitations: Chrome simulated viewports, not real mobile or cross-browser or screen-reader certification.
Next and multiple UI kits are explicit observation tasks, not installed and tested.
No production auth, persistence, deployment or human learner trial; Nuxt signal is a type contract, not remote cancellation proof.
